name: Dotfiles
description: Clones a dotfiles repository and runs its install.sh script when present.

repository.description: Git URL of the dotfiles repository to clone.

branch.description: Optional branch to check out. By default, the repository's default branch is used.

gitName.description: Git user.name passed to install.sh. Set together with gitEmail to run the installer noninteractively.

gitEmail.description: Git user.email passed to install.sh. Set together with gitName to run the installer noninteractively.
